Children: William (1895), Mary Ann (1897), Albert Ernest (1898), Catherine (1899, d. inf.), Hugh (1900-1972), Samuel (1903-1973, M0002), Ellen (1906, the direct ancestor). Note the export knew nothing of this family beyond Ellen.

DEATH — TWO CANDIDATES: William Larkin d. Jun Q 1918 Whitehaven aged 60 (b. ~1858 — matches the census's ~1857, and a 1918 death would neatly explain Ellen's 1921 departure to relatives), or d. Mar Q 1940 aged 83 (b. ~1857). One of the two is this man, the other is the William Larkin who married Mary Elliot in 1884. Death certificates or the 1939 Register would split them. If OURS died in 1918, then the 'Thomas Larkin d. 1920 Maine' of the export is definitively a different man — plausibly the relative Ellen was sent to.
